mysql_schema.show_create_table:
CREATE TABLE `scenes` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `video_id` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `start_time` double NOT NULL,
  `end_time` double NOT NULL,
  `object_labels` text,
  `species_resolution_json` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `object_detections_json` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `s3_key` text,
  `created_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_scenes_video_time` (`video_id`,`start_time`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=1573 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
